Pair a Recontextualization Evaluation Table With a No-Change Baseline

Source: R/baseline_evaluation.R
paired_eval_table.Rd

Merges a sig_eval_table() result with a saved no-change evaluation table, adds paired delta metrics, prints median performance and paired Wilcoxon meta-test summaries, and returns the paired table.

Usage

paired_eval_table(combined_df, no_change_eval_path)

Arguments

combined_df

A data frame returned by sig_eval_table() for a recontextualized/predicted signature set.

no_change_eval_path

File path to an .rds containing the no-change sig_eval_table() output.

Value

A tibble containing paired no-change (*_FALSE) and predicted (*_TRUE) metrics, plus kept_alpha, NES_delta, and Jacc_delta.
